suite: V2.11 privacy and local monitoring interactions

results.name: One privacy draft list resumes the exact saved activity, DPIA and case steps
Draft discovery respects selected organizational scope without deleting hidden drafts
Privacy completeness reuses source validators and links each issue to its step and field
Invalid forward navigation shows correction links and does not submit or lose the draft
Final DPIA review links missing facts while preserving the recommendation editor
Case preparation exposes separate Save progress and Submit for review actions
Enter-key/default case submission saves progress; only explicit review intent advances it
Returned case comments remain visible and escaped beside the correction form
Running one local integration check records one source observation and no conclusion
Privacy and monitoring interaction controls register real actions and destination routes
